mainEntity.name: Do you repair coolrooms and commercial fridges in the Granville industrial area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair coolrooms, freezer rooms, upright and under-bench fridges, display cabinets and ice machines for businesses in Granville, Silverwater and Camellia. Commercial jobs are quoted separately, with a call-out of about $100 to $250.

mainEntity.name: What should I tell you about my site when I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Give us the street address and the unit or gate details, the equipment and brand, and what it is doing. If there are loading dock times, gate codes or site induction rules, tell us so we arrive ready to start.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair home fridges in Granville as well?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We repair fridges and freezers in Granville homes and units. Most domestic repairs cost $150 to $450 including parts, plus a call-out of about $60 to $200. You get a fixed quote before we start.

mainEntity.name: My business fridge or coolroom has stopped. What should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep the doors shut and check the power and any isolator. Move high-risk food such as meat, dairy and seafood to a working fridge or a cooler with ice, because cold food should stay at 5°C or below. Then book online or email us with the equipment and what it is doing.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can a technician get to Granville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our technicians are based in Parramatta, so Granville is a short trip. Same-day visits are available where we have a slot, and booking early in the day gives you the best chance. We confirm a time when you book.

mainEntity.name: Do prices change for Granville or Silverwater?

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed to repair commercial refrigeration in Granville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our work is carried out by licensed refrigeration mechanics (Lic #R38910) who are ARC licensed to handle refrigerant. We are independent and not tied to any brand, so we tell you plainly when a repair is not worth it.
